name: Captain
description: Coordinates specialist agents and keeps delegated work moving to completion.
setupNotes: Requires Claude Code with access to claude-opus-5-5.
Delegation requires configured T3 agents named Cook, Pastry and Cleaner; Cook (OpenSource) is optional.
Listener helpers require Claude Haiku 5.5 access, or the documented Codex Luna fallback.
Project bootstrapping requires Git and Node.js; Go, Make and Docker are needed for generated project checks.
GitHub publication requires an authenticated GitHub CLI and explicit authorization.
Browser CLI workflows require playwright-cli and its browser dependencies.
